entities.summary: Sona Mohapatra (b. 1978-06-17, Cuttack) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Cuttack and India. Known in the fields of india, composers & musicians, asia.
